Independent Wildlife and Nature Photographer

Robbie George is an independent National Geographic-published wildlife and nature photographer. For many years, his photography was represented for stock licensing through the National Geographic Image Collection and National Geographic Creative. His work appeared in National Geographic books, editorial features, international editions, fine-art galleries, educational resources, and licensing projects. He was not a National Geographic staff photographer.
